mass_implementation_recheck.definition: 2*sum(w_i*C_i)+ell=C0; ell derivative uses the same surface flux as C RHS.
mass_implementation_recheck.production_implementation_scope: All N+1 state nodes at all accepted times. Reported-time completion also all N+1 nodes.
mass_implementation_recheck.independence_limit: This invariant checks self-consistency of assembled numerical conservation. It is not an external water-mass experiment or independent constitutive/energy validation.

new_findings.finding: Spatial and temporal field differences use 21 fixed physical radii, not every solver node or the whole continuous radius. Q4 moving surface is often excluded from these samples.
new_findings.suggested_wording: 场误差统计是在全部公共整数秒、21个固定物理半径上的最大差；Q4仅比较共域有限点，另检查已保存每60s的真实表面。它不是全节点或连续移动域的一致误差界。

new_findings.finding: Actual Python rounding of tighter temporal-control outputs changes some fourth decimal digits, despite field differences much less than half a display unit.
new_findings.suggested_wording: 四位小数仅为题目输出格式，不能保证所有末位稳定；实际收紧时间设置已观察到少量舍入末位变化。正式表保持所声明基准解的格式化输出。

new_findings.finding: Historical full-second coarse spatial projections were not persisted; current recheck independently reduces retained sparse material samples and event differences, but cannot independently reproduce all original full-second spatial maxima without rerunning PDE.
new_findings.suggested_wording: 本轮重新核验原空间报告、相应源码字节及保存样本；全秒空间极值沿用该次真实运行报告，未声称本轮重新归约未保存的全秒粗网格场。

new_findings.finding: Temporal test changes rtol, both atols, early max step and late max step simultaneously. It is numerical sensitivity at fixed N, not isolated fixed-step convergence order or a strict time error bound.
new_findings.suggested_wording: 同N时间设置敏感性联合收紧局部容差与最大步长；该差不被解释为纯步长阶或严格时间误差界。

new_findings.finding: Mass uses shared discrete boundary flux and passive loss state; it checks conservation self-consistency. Bessel independently validates linear heat or frozen-D algorithms only. Neither supplies internal experimental truth.

Two v3 reports originally lacked a matching saved driver; root deterministically reconstructed the one-keyword variant, and this reviewer independently verified its 5356 bytes and exact recorded SHA256. It was not run.

event_conclusion: dry_event and completion each take all N+1 nodes. At reported time the stored all-node certificate is below 0.15, and retained center samples match. Piecewise linear spatial interpolation cannot exceed its endpoint maxima, so the numerical interpolant is strictly below at that time. Exact continuum truth still lacks a certified spatial bound. Full all-node dense states were released, so this recheck does not replay the certificate over all nodes.
Richardson_conclusion: Computed p and remaining indicators match quoted values. For max-norm sampled fields, error profiles and extremum locations may shift (observed Q4 time shift); no asymptotic expansion/strict bound established. Event extrapolation remains conditional and must not replace the computed trajectory.

data.scope: Same final N, baseline versus tight tolerances and step caps; actual x=1 surface at common regular 60 s times only. Not all seconds or a continuous error bound.
